name: Systems Modeling Language version 2 and its API and Services
uses: System models of physical things as a graph of part definitions and usages, with a REST API to query and update a model. The planned backbone of the physical systems framework.
gaps: It models a system but not the venture that makes it, sells it or decides about it.
note: Copyright is open for the specification documents as OMG publishes them; check the license before copying text.
